targets.query:
from(bucket:"zaxenergy")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "energy" and r.unit == "${unit}" and r._field == "kwh")
  |> group(columns: ["phase", "unit"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> difference(nonNegative: true, columns: ["_value"])

phaseData = from(bucket:"zaxenergy")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "energy" and r.unit == "${unit}" and r._field == "kwh")
  |> group(columns: ["phase", "unit"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> difference(nonNegative: true, columns: ["_value"])
  |> sum(column: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: now(), _value: r._value, phase: r.phase}))

totalData = from(bucket:"zaxenergy")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "energy" and r.unit == "${unit}" and r._field == "kwh")
  |> group(columns: ["phase", "unit"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> difference(nonNegative: true, columns: ["_value"])
  |> group()
  |> sum(column: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: now(), _value: r._value, phase: "Total"}))

union(tables: [phaseData, totalData])
  |> group(columns: ["phase"])

import "date"

from(bucket:"zaxenergy")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "energy" and r.unit == "${unit}" and r._field == "kwh")
  |> group(columns: ["phase", "unit"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> difference(nonNegative: false, columns: ["_value"])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value < -0.0001)
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: date.truncate(t: r._time, unit: 1m), unit: r.unit, _value: 1.0}))
  |> unique(column: "_time")
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)

from(bucket:"zaxenergy")
  |> range(start: -30d)
  |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "data_gap")
  |> filter(fn:(r) => r._field == "status" or r._field == "duration_s" or r._field == "recovered_count")
  |> pivot(rowKey:["_time","unit"], columnKey:["_field"], valueColumn:"_value")
  |> filter(fn:(r) => r.status != "recovered")
  |> sort(columns:["_time"], desc:true)
  |> keep(columns:["_time","unit","status","duration_s","recovered_count"])
